findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company, list_sources, lobby_read, lobby_inbox, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation, fill_template · Private data: list_actions, get_company, find_law, lobby_register, lobby_delete, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation, list_templates, fill_template, list_operations, order_operation · Public sink: lobby_post, lobby_send, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation · Destructive: lobby_post, lobby_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company, list_sources, lobby_read, lobby_inbox, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation, fill_template · Private data: list_actions, get_company, find_law, lobby_register, lobby_delete, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation, list_templates, fill_template, list_operations, order_operation · Public sink: lobby_post, lobby_send, get_formation_guide, get_post_formation · Destructive: lobby_post, lobby_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
